qualifications: This is an observed GitHub query result set, not certified exhaustive.
Detailed issue bodies were inspected after title-only and eligibility-rule freeze.
Researcher labels are post-body and have no independent annotator adjudication.
Prior P35 Restic source arms are bounded API-compatible research implementations, not alternate full restic applications.
No actual source-level U/C paired repair can be asserted without same old/new contract and native tests.
No statistical inference across task types or projects; correlated demand sampling.
